info.title: Germany & EU Jobs API: Arbeitnow Jobs with Visa Filter
info.description:
Live jobs from Germany and the EU as JSON: filter by keywords, city, remote, visa sponsorship, tags, job type and posting date in one call.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/germany-jobs (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Collect Arbeitnow job board records and export title, url, description, created at, slug, tags as structured JSON, CSV or Excel data. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep jobs whose title, company, description or tags contain any of these words (case-insensitive), e.g. python, data engineer, Pflege. Empty keeps every job.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Keep jobs whose location contains any of these texts, e.g. Berlin, München, Germany. Empty keeps every location.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs Arbeitnow marks as remote.

visaSponsorship.title: Visa sponsorship only
visaSponsorship.description: Ask Arbeitnow for jobs that offer visa sponsorship or relocation help (its own visa_sponsorship filter). Rows then carry visa_sponsorship: true.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Keep jobs that have a tag containing any of these texts, e.g. Software Development, Marketing. Up to 20.

jobTypes.title: Job types
jobTypes.description: Keep jobs with a job type containing any of these texts, e.g. full time, Vollzeit, Praktikum, berufserfahren. Arbeitnow labels many German jobs in German.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within days
postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs posted in the last N days. 0 means any date.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Jobs to return, newest first. A request returns 20 jobs at most.

201.description: The results, one object per row.
